remarks:
This 29.75+/- acre recreational parcel off Dredge Ditch Road offers a strong mix of creek-bottom habitat, open ground, wetlands, and edge cover in a productive rural setting. Access is provided by easement from a seasonal road to the recently surveyed parcel.
The property is bordered on the west by a tributary of Conewango Creek and Mill Run Creek, with year-round water running along the property. The land includes approximately 3.8+/- acres of open field currently well-suited for food plot use, flat ground, and hardwood edge habitat that supports a strong mix of waterfowl and deer recreation.
Surrounded by productive agricultural ground with timber nearby, the property has the right ingredients for duck, goose, and deer activity. An existing tower blind is already in place, and the open field, creek corridor, and wetland cover provide a solid base for additional blinds, habitat work, or seasonal recreational use.
This is not a conventional residential building parcel. The access, seasonal road, wetlands, and lack of utilities make it better positioned for hunting, wildlife use, and simple seasonal recreation. A rustic off-grid camp or cabin concept may be possible subject to applicable approvals, but the property should be viewed first and foremost as a recreational tract.
Minor gas royalties are associated with the property, and all gas, mineral, and oil rights owned by the seller will convey.
Do not enter the property without an agent present.
